name: Constant Contact
description: Constant Contact is a digital and email marketing platform that helps small businesses build email and SMS campaigns, landing pages, event marketing, and automations from a single tool, with integrations that keep contacts and order data in sync.
best_for: Positioned for small businesses, nonprofits, and local service providers that want an easy-to-use platform for email and SMS marketing, event promotion, and sign-up forms with accessible phone support.
features: Automated email sends for events like welcomes, birthdays, and re-sends to non-openers
SMS marketing with automated VIP alerts, abandoned-cart reminders, and event updates
Custom automation paths with branching and triggered actions
Website sign-up forms, pop-ups, and lead-generation landing pages
Event registration management, ticketing, and invitation tracking
Integrations with popular CRMs and e-commerce platforms to sync contacts and orders

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.notes: Starts at $12/month for up to 500 contacts. Includes basic email marketing, automated welcome emails, social marketing, and event management.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Starts at $35/month for up to 500 contacts. Adds A/B testing, segmentation, automated resending to non-openers, and social ads integration.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Starts at $80/month for up to 500 contacts. Adds dynamic content, custom automation paths, custom segmentation, and advanced SEO tools.

pros: Beginner-friendly email builder with built-in event marketing and registration tools
Live phone and chat customer support across all plan tiers
Automated resend feature to automatically message non-openers
cons: No permanent free plan; free trial is time-limited
Contact-tiered pricing scales up quickly as subscriber lists grow
Advanced workflow automation is restricted to higher tiers

faq.question: Does Constant Contact offer a free plan?
faq.answer: No, Constant Contact does not offer a permanent free plan, but provides a free trial (typically 14 to 30 days depending on region) to test campaign features.

faq.question: How does Constant Contact pricing work?
faq.answer: Constant Contact prices on a contact-tiered structure starting at $12/month (Lite), $35/month (Standard), and $80/month (Premium) for 500 contacts, with costs increasing as your contact database expands.

faq.question: Does Constant Contact support SMS marketing?
faq.answer: Yes, Constant Contact supports integrated SMS marketing campaigns, automated abandoned-cart alerts, and VIP text broadcasts alongside email.

alternatives.name: Moosend
alternatives.description: A budget-friendly email marketing and automation platform offering unlimited sends on Pro tiers.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting unlimited email sends and affordable automation starting at $9/month

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: An integrated marketing and CRM platform with volume-based pricing for email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a pay-per-send model with a free tier and multi-channel messaging

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting a vast integration ecosystem and template library

alternatives.name: Zoho Campaigns
alternatives.description: An AI-powered email, SMS, and WhatsApp marketing platform with contact-tier pricing and deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want low-cost, contact-tiered email marketing
